annotations.title: Test a research pipeline on placebo data

description: Does your pipeline find edges in noise? plan writes placebo files (your data's returns in random orders, so nothing is predictable); run the whole pipeline on real.csv and on each, then compare for a p-value that counts every choice it makes. Beating the placebos shows the pipeline finds more in the real order of the returns than in random orders of the same returns; it does not show the edge survives costs, capacity or the future.

data_file.description: plan, on your machine: CSV or JSON, a column per asset, dates optional.

placebo_results.description: compare: its result on each placebo, in file order.

real.description: compare: the pipeline's result on the real data.

name: placebo_test

outputSchema.description: plan: dir, real.csv and the placebo files, method and seed. compare: verdict, p_value, and what the pipeline found on the placebos.

title: Test a research pipeline on placebo data
